newsitem.title: USA: Continental cuts winter, spring fares.
newsitem.headline: Continental cuts winter, spring fares.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said Tuesday it was offering reduced travel fares for late winter and up to June 11.
The round-trip, off-peak offer will cut fares under the airline's structured 21-day fares by anywhere from 9 percent to 51 percent, it said.
Air tickets must be purchased 14 days in advance and no later than February 4 and within 24 hours of making a reservation, it said.
The reduced fares are valid throughout the U.S. and Canada, Continental said.

Sample fares: the Providence,-Denver, round-trip ticket would be reduced to $398 or by 9 percent, from $438; Los Angeles-Newark/New York to $438 or by 50 percent, from $877; Seattle-New Orleans to $378 or by 51 percent, from $776; Boston-Houston, to $378 or by 49 percent, from $742; and Newark/New York-Houston, to $378 or by 41 percent, from $641.
Continental said it was also extending until Febvruary 4 the purchase period for its previously announced sale fares to Europe and for certain destinations in Mexicon and Central America.
